start: Gym tab with no gym, card 'Find my gym with my number'; the person is on a MettleUp gym's list with a plan running today

user_sees: 'We check your number against the member lists of gyms that use MettleUp. We only show you your own gym.'
Boxes 'Your mobile number' and 'Your first name, as your gym has it'
'Your number is checked once and is not kept for this.'
must_not: The number box keeping '+91 ' or spaces

steps.action: Type the number and first name, tap 'Check with WhatsApp'
user_sees: WhatsApp opens with a ready message to MettleUp; the app shows 'Send the message in WhatsApp'
must_not: A charge or a message sent without the person tapping send

steps.action: Send it in WhatsApp and come back
user_sees: 'Looking for your gym...' then 'You are a member of <gym>', 'Your plan runs until <date>.', button 'Join <gym>'
must_not: Another person's gym shown
A gym where the plan ended

user_sees: The join page of that gym's code; after the join the plan's paid features open
must_not: The join landing on another gym

start: First screen (Welcome), 'Continue with your phone number' (the sign-in way in)

steps.action: Tap 'Continue with your phone number', type number and name, tap 'Check with WhatsApp', send it
user_sees: 'Looking for your gym...' then 'We found you: <role at gym>.' or 'We found you at <n> gyms. Pick the gym to open in the app.'
must_not: A gym the number is not listed at

user_sees: 'Opening <gym>…'
must_not: The setup questions skipped with no gym joined

start: Find my gym form, wrong input

user_sees: 'Type your 10-digit mobile number.'
must_not: WhatsApp opening for a wrong number

user_sees: 'Type your first name, as your gym has it.'
must_not: A search with no name

steps.action: Send the WhatsApp from another number
user_sees: 'The message came from a different number. Send it from the WhatsApp of the number you typed.'
must_not: The other number's gym shown

start: Not on any gym's list (or the plan ended)

user_sees: 'We did not find your gym'
'We look only for a plan that runs today, under the number and first name your gym has for you.'
Buttons 'Tell my gym' and 'Skip'
must_not: A made-up gym outside a test build

user_sees: 'This number has been checked too many times today. Try again tomorrow.'
must_not: An endless 'Looking for your gym...'

start: Check started, WhatsApp not sent; the check runs out

user_sees: 'The check ran out of time. Tap Start again.' and 'Start again'
must_not: A found gym from an old check

user_sees: The form again with the typed values
must_not: A second WhatsApp prompt with the old code

start: Not found, the person types the gym's name and city and taps 'Tell my gym'

steps.action: Type 'Gym name (optional)' and 'City (optional)', tap 'Tell my gym'
user_sees: 'If you type your gym’s name and city, the MettleUp team may contact your gym. We never share your number.'
The share menu with a ready message
must_not: The person's mobile number sent with the gym lead
The number kept after the check (promise: not kept for this)

start: New phone, first screen, member listed at a MettleUp gym with a running plan

user_sees: Title 'Continue with your phone number'
'If your gym uses MettleUp, it may already have your number. We use it to find your gym and link this app to it.'
must_not: A sign-in that needs a password

steps.action: Type number and first name, 'Check with WhatsApp', send, come back
user_sees: 'We found you: <member at gym>.'
'Your plan runs until <date>.'
must_not: The plan of another member with the same number but another name

user_sees: 'Opening <gym>…', then the Gym tab of that gym
must_not: The member linked to the gym's list twice

start: Joined through 'Find my gym' then the join page (the claim after the join)

user_sees: The plan shown at once (the same proof links the list member)
must_not: 'Check in once to link your membership' shown when the claim went through

steps.action: Join more than 15 minutes after the check
user_sees: The join works; the desk confirms the number at check-in instead
must_not: An error about the proof shown to the member

start: Sign-in with a number no gym has

user_sees: 'We did not find your number at a gym on MettleUp'
'...You can still use the app without a gym: tap "Set up the app".'
'Try another number'
must_not: A gym shown from a partial name match

steps.action: Server without the WhatsApp member check
user_sees: 'Signing in with your number is not open yet. Tap Back, then Try another way, then Join my gym, and type your gym’s 6-letter code.'
must_not: A dead button

user_sees: 'We found you at 2 gyms. Pick the gym to open in the app.'
must_not: Only one gym shown

steps.action: Pick one, then go back and pick the other
user_sees: The app opens the picked gym; the proof is used once
must_not: Both gyms joined at once
The used proof accepted again after 15 minutes

user_sees: 'We only use your number to find your gym. Your number is checked once and is not kept for this.'
must_not: The number stored for this search
Other gyms the number is listed at named, beyond the person's own
